WITH latest AS (
    SELECT ts FROM bankstate_runtime_snapshot
    ORDER BY ts DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT e.*
FROM bankstate_engine_snapshot e
JOIN latest l ON e.ts = l.ts
ORDER BY engine;

SELECT ts, COUNT(*) as rows_per_ts
FROM bankstate_engine_snapshot
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 5;
